Q: Docker Server Error : request returned Internal Server Error for API route and version A:

Maybe you should try running docker with sudo. Im not sure why it works but it helped me get past this problem.

Q: Text Editor in C++ A:

"I think that it is easier to work with RAM in C" - Everything you can do in C you can also do exactly the same in C++.

Q: "Your GStreamer installation is missing a plug-in." (GstURIDecodeBin) A:

1. Install Necessary GStreamer Packages

The error "No suitable plugins found" usually means needed codecs (like H.264, H.265, or AV1) are missing. Run the following command to install the base, good, bad, and ugly plugin sets, along with libav for codec support:

bash

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes \
    gstreamer1.0-tools \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-base \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-good \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad \
    gstreamer1.0-plugins-ugly \
    gstreamer1.0-libav

  • gstreamer1.0-plugins-bad: Contains decodebin3 and many modern demuxers/decoders.

  • gstreamer1.0-libav: Contains many decoders required for high-quality playback (e.g., avdec_h264).

Q: Trying to test SAML auth with open/free SAML IDP A:

Try https://samlforge.com instead. You can easily configure mock SAML IdP. No registration is necessary.

Q: Testing SP-Initiated Saml 2.0 SSO: is there a IDP that supports dynamic ACS URL? A:

Try https://samlforge.com. It has dynamic workspace-specific ACS urls
